import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from model_runtime.deterministic_discovery import discover


class DeterministicDiscoveryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_benutzerfilter_prefers_real_user_files(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp)
            (root / ".git").mkdir()
            (root / "nav").mkdir()
            (root / "inc").mkdir()
            (root / "docs").mkdir()

            (root / "nav" / "settings_benutzer.php").write_text(
                "<?php\n$suche = $_GET[\'suche\'] ?? \'\';\n$benutzer_liste = benutzer_array();\nif ($benutzer_liste === []) { echo \'Noch keine Benutzer vorhanden.\'; }\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (root / "inc" / "funktionen_benutzer.php").write_text(
                "<?php\nfunction benutzer_array() { return []; }\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (root / "docs" / "benutzer.md").write_text(
                "benutzer benutzer_array suche filter",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            result = discover(root)
            paths = [item["path"] for item in result["candidates"]]

            self.assertIn("nav/settings_benutzer.php", paths[:2])
            self.assertIn("inc/funktionen_benutzer.php", paths[:3])
            self.assertNotIn("docs/benutzer.md", paths)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
